items.title: Skoda Auto India unveils upgraded Kodiaq range with Lounge variant, ADAS upgrades
items.summary: The Kodiaq Sportline gets a key upgrade for 2026 with the addition of a full suite of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), including adaptive cruise control, lane assist, blind spot detection, rear traffic alert and exit warning.

items.title: Hyundai pins hopes on new SUV launches in FY27 to regain lost ground
items.summary: The company is betting on two new SUVs in FY27 to drive volumes and regain ground in the Indian market, where domestic OEMs overtook the Korean carmaker in FY26 amid intensifying competition in the SUV segment.
